name: Barbell Thruster
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your front shoulders with elbows lifted slightly forward.
Brace your trunk and bend your knees and hips into a front squat, keeping the bar balanced over the middle of your feet.
Drive explosively upward out of the squat, carrying that momentum directly into pressing the barbell locked straight overhead.
Lower the bar smoothly back to your front shoulders and transition cleanly into the next squat.
tips: Time the press as your hips extend out of the squat for one seamless drive.
Keep your chest tall and heels flat during the squat so the bar stays balanced over your midfoot.
